Hero carousel configuration. Edit this file to manage slides — no code changes required.

  SIMPLE entry  →  just a filename string (uses all defaults below)
  RICH entry    →  an object with optional overrides

  Supported image formats: .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .webp
  Images are shown in the order listed here.

  Per-image properties (all optional):
    file                — filename inside assets/img/carousel/   (required)
    objectPosition      — CSS object-position for desktop         default: center 70%
    objectPositionTablet — override for tablets (≤ 900 px)       default: inherits objectPosition
    objectPositionMobile — override for phones (≤ 600 px)        default: inherits objectPosition
    duration            — hold time in milliseconds               default: 7000

  TIP: For exterior shots showing a building, center 70–75% keeps the
  facade visible and reduces empty sky. Use center 50% for interiors.
